data.summary: Process Excellence Manager and certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with 10+ years of experience driving process re-engineering, digital transformation, and continuous improvement across Banking, Financial Services (O2C, R2R, P2P), Insurance, and Healthcare domains. Proven track record of delivering 18+ transformation projects, mentoring 11+ LSS projects, and scaling AI-driven, RPA, and Agentic AI automation solutions. Strong expertise in Banking KYC/CDD process discovery, risk/compliance operations, stakeholder consulting, and cross-functional team leadership. Seeking to drive enterprise-scale operational transformation and process excellence.

raw_sections.summary:
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Process Excellence Manager and certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with 10+ years of experience driving process re-engineering, digital transformation, and continuous improvement across Banking, Financial Services (O2C, R2R, P2P), Insurance, and Healthcare domains. Proven track record of delivering 18+ transformation projects, mentoring 11+ LSS projects, and scaling AI-driven, RPA, and Agentic AI automation solutions. Strong expertise in Banking KYC/CDD process discovery, risk/compliance operations, stakeholder consulting, and cross-functional team leadership. Seeking to drive enterprise-scale operational transformation and process excellence.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
Methodologies & Frameworks: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, DMAIC, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Upstream-Downstream Analysis, Process Mapping, SAFe Agile, BPMN, PMP (Trained)
Domain & Compliance: Banking Operations (CDD / KYC & Onboarding), Financial Operations (O2C, R2R, P2P), Governance & Internal Controls
Automation & AI: Robotic Process Automation (UiPath), Agentic AI, Gen AI, LangChain, Python, Zapier Workflow Automation
Tools & Analytics: Minitab, Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, MS Visio, Draw.io, Mural
Core Competencies: Stakeholder Management & Consulting, Training & Mentorship, Process Discovery, Presentation & Articulation, Escalation Management
raw_sections.experience:
WORK HISTORY
Process Excellence Manager  |  Tech Mahindra, Noida, India	Jan 2024 – Nov 2025
Led end-to-end Lean Six Sigma Black Belt automation projects across Finance and BFSI KYC operations, driving process re-engineering and enabling 23+ FTE capacity savings.
Designed and executed Lean Six Sigma workshops to train, coach, and mobilize teams on LSS frameworks, methodologies, and continuous improvement practices.
Implemented enterprise UiPath automation solutions (Amazon Invoice Bot & Cupa Cash Application Bot), eliminating manual intervention and saving 9,000+ operational minutes.
Deployed Agentic AI and Zapier email automation workflows for order status queries, delivering 2 FTE direct capacity savings.
Leveraged LangChain and OpenAI to build a document-based conversational AI chatbot, enabling automated multi-turn information retrieval and process optimization.
Process Excellence Manager  |  EY Pvt Ltd, Gurgaon, India	Oct 2021 – Nov 2023
Spearheaded global Banking transformation for HSBC (MIDAS program), specializing in Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and KYC onboarding processes.
Led global process discovery initiatives using Lean Six Sigma methodologies, mapping end-to-end workflows, identifying upstream/downstream dependencies, and resolving critical process gaps.
Conceptualized and delivered LSS training workshops to build continuous improvement capabilities across cross-functional global teams.
Advised executive stakeholders on target operating models, process standardization, and governance frameworks to enhance operational efficiency and audit readiness.
Associate Manager – Process Excellence  |  British Telecom Pvt Ltd, Gurgaon, India	Dec 2016 – May 2020
Led a cross-functional Lean Six Sigma project to optimize Procurement cycle time, delivering a 40% reduction in cycle time across the end-to-end P2P lifecycle.
Streamlined P2P and O2C operations by eliminating non-value-added activities, standardizing SOPs, and driving ERP-enabled process automation.
Spearheaded O2C transformation (Ordering, Invoicing, Collections, AR Ageing) for the EMEA region, recovering $34,000 through database error resolution and achieving 1 FTE saving.
Senior Quality Analyst  |  Xchanging Technology Pvt Ltd, Gurgaon, India	Dec 2015 – Dec 2016
Reduced policy issuance TAT by 50% through continuous improvement projects, process re-engineering, and tight IT system integration.
Conducted Lean Six Sigma training workshops, mentoring associates on problem-solving frameworks, root cause analysis, and process controls.
Quality Analyst  |  NTT Data Pvt Ltd, Gurgaon, India	Dec 2013 – Dec 2015
Delivered continuous improvement initiatives across Finance (O2C, P2P, R2R) and Healthcare operations, optimizing invoice processing and reducing turnaround times.
Developed standard operating procedures (SOPs), detailed process maps, and quality monitoring dashboards to maintain high operational compliance.
